readme:
# Kazama — Railway Ubuntu SSH

Your own cloud workstation on Railway. SSH in as **root** on Ubuntu 26.04.

## Deploy
1. Set a **ROOT_PASSWORD** (required) in the Variables tab.
2. The template opens a **TCP Proxy** on port `22` automatically.
3. Redeploy, then connect:

```bash
ssh root@<your-railway-domain> -p <port>
```

## Variables
- `ROOT_PASSWORD` (required) — root password
- `SSH_USERNAME` / `SSH_PASSWORD` (optional) — secondary sudo user
- `AUTHORIZED_KEYS` (optional) — SSH public key(s) for root
- `TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY` (optional) — private SSH over Tailscale, no public TCP Proxy needed
- `GITHUB_TOKEN` (optional) — auto-backup `/root/src` to a private `kazama-src-<id>` repo, restored on every redeploy
- `SYNC_INTERVAL` (optional, default `180`) — sync interval in seconds
- `RAILWAY_TOKEN` (optional) — account token for live credit in `usage`
- `APP_LANG` (optional, default `en`) — `en` or `id`

Guide to creating the GitHub token: see `docs/TOKENS.md` in the repo.

ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Mandatory password for the root user. The container refuses to start without it. Change it after first login.

SSH_USERNAME.description: Optional secondary sudo user. Must be set together with SSH_PASSWORD.

SSH_PASSWORD.description: Password for the optional sudo user. Set together with SSH_USERNAME.

AUTHORIZED_KEYS.description: SSH public key(s) for root key-based authentication. Password login stays enabled.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub token with 'repo' scope. When set, /root/src is backed up to a PRIVATE repo named kazama-src-<id> and restored on every redeploy.

SYNC_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between automatic /root/src syncs (min 30; only used when GITHUB_TOKEN is set).

SRC_REPO.description: Optional: pin the backup repository name (e.g. to restore into a new Railway project).

RAILWAY_TOKEN.description: Optional Railway account token — lets the 'usage' command read your real remaining credit.

APP_LANG.description: Runtime message language: en (English) or id (Bahasa Indonesia).

TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY.description: Optional Tailscale auth key (reusable + ephemeral recommended). Enables private SSH over your tailnet — no public TCP Proxy needed. Tailscale must run on the device you connect from.

TAILSCALE_HOSTNAME.description: Machine name shown in your Tailscale admin.
